message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
trace = [
    {"step":1,"file":"src/bin/fuzz/config_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":43,"var":"data/size","code":"memcpy(static_data, data, size);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are copied into a mutable buffer before parsing."},
    {"step":2,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"config_open_for_fuzzing","line":777,"var":"len","code":"return config_init_data(config, data, len - 1);","note":"The copied bytes become the exact parser span."},
    {"step":3,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"config_init_data","line":792,"var":"lexer.pos/end","code":".pos = data, .start = data, .end = (char *)data + len,","note":"The lexer tracks the attacker-controlled end pointer for the input."},
    {"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_config","line":463,"var":"chr","code":"if (chr == '$' && peek(lexer) == '{') return lex_variable;","note":"A dollar-sign prefix causes the lexer to inspect the next byte and transition into variable parsing."},
    {"step":5,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_variable","line":381,"var":"lexer->pos","code":"advance_n(lexer, strlen(\"${\") - 1);","note":"The variable lexer advances the cursor past the opening sequence before scanning the body."},
    {"step":6,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_variable","line":388,"var":"chr","code":"chr = next(lexer);","note":"The lexer consumes the next byte as part of the variable body or terminator check."},
    {"step":7,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_variable","line":399,"var":"lexeme->type","code":"emit(lexer, LEXEME_VARIABLE);","note":"When a closing brace is seen, the token is emitted and later parsed as a variable reference."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')))
print('trace updated')
PY` executed with exit code 0.
